name: WSDL Types
description: Schema describing the types element of a WSDL 2.0 document. The types element encloses data type definitions (typically XML Schema) used by the web service messages.

targetNamespace.description: The target namespace of the embedded schema definition.

elementFormDefault.description: Whether locally declared elements must be namespace-qualified.

items.description: An inline XML Schema or other type system definition.

schema.description: A list of type system definitions embedded in or imported by the WSDL document.

namespace.description: The namespace URI of the imported schema.

schemaLocation.description: The location of the imported schema document.

import.description: A list of imported type definitions from external schemas.
